privacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicyPage.intro: SmartPlan AI (“SmartPlan AI”, “we”, “us”, or “our”) is an AI-powered architectural and interior design platform. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect personal information when you use our website and services.
privacyPolicyPage.collectIntro: Depending on how you use SmartPlan AI, we may collect:
privacyPolicyPage.collectItem1: Account information such as your name and email address when you register or sign in.
privacyPolicyPage.collectItem2: Project-related content you upload or provide, such as floor plans, room photos, measurements, and design preferences.
privacyPolicyPage.collectItem3: Usage data such as feature usage, device or browser type, and general interaction logs to improve reliability and performance.
privacyPolicyPage.collectItem4: Communications you send to us (for example, support requests or feedback submitted through the app).
privacyPolicyPage.useBody: We use the information we collect to provide and improve our AI design services, including generating and analyzing layout suggestions, processing your requests, securing your account, communicating with you about the service, and understanding how the platform is used so we can enhance the experience. We do not sell your personal data.
privacyPolicyPage.storageBody: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures designed to protect your information against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Data may be stored on secure servers and processed in accordance with applicable laws. No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure; we strive to follow industry practices appropriate to the nature of the data we handle.
privacyPolicyPage.thirdPartyBody: We may use trusted third-party providers for hosting, analytics, email delivery, or other infrastructure. Those providers process data only as needed to perform our services and are expected to comply with contractual and legal obligations. We encourage you to review their privacy policies where applicable.
privacyPolicyPage.rightsBody: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete your personal information, restrict or object to certain processing, or request a copy of your data. You may request deletion of your account or assistance with data export where technically feasible. To exercise these rights, contact us using the details below.
privacyPolicyPage.contactBody: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at privacy@smartplan.ai.
